t: 1,但老瑞士邦联的军队在Näfels战役中战胜了奥地利的Archduchy.
te: 1, forces of the Old Swiss Confederacy are victorious over the Archduchy of Austria in the Battle of Näfels.
dz: 尽管人数已超过16:1,但老瑞士邦联的军队在Näfels战役中战胜了奥地利的Archduchy.
de: Despite being outnumbered 16:1, forces of the Old Swiss Confederacy are victorious over the Archduchy of Austria in the Battle of Näfels.

dz: 雅典阿克罗波利斯人向内里奥·阿克西亚奥利投降,结束了加泰罗尼亚在雅典公国的存在.
de: The surrender of the Acropolis of Athens to Nerio Acciaioli ends the Catalan presence in the Duchy of Athens.

dz: 布玉湖之战中，蓝玉将军率领明军前去镇压北元可汗脱居帖木儿的蒙古大军。
de: During the Battle of Buyur Lake, General Lan Yu leads a Ming army forward to crush the Mongol hordes of Tögüs Temür, the Khan of Northern Yuan.

de: The Battle of Otterburn, a border skirmish between the Scottish and the English in Northern England, is fought near Otterburn.
